programmes.amount_note: Maximum credit of EUR 10 million for technical development projects and EUR 5 million for clinical development projects. For small companies RVO finances a maximum of 45% of development costs (50% when the project is carried out in collaboration); the applicant must finance at least 55% from other sources. Total 2026 budget EUR 50,000,000. The credit is repaid only if the project succeeds.
programmes.deadline_note: 'Open voor aanvragen' — applications are accepted year-round while budget lasts.

procedure_steps.detail: Check that the project has high technical or clinical risk and that the product can be brought to market within 5 years.
Secure at least 55% of the development costs from other sources.
Submit the application to RVO with the business case and financing plan.
Report progress to RVO during the project; at completion RVO determines 'het subsidiebedrag en het aflossingsschema' (the amount and the repayment schedule).

documents_required.doc: Project plan showing technical or clinical risk and route to market within 5 years
Financing plan evidencing at least 55% co-financing

eligibility.other_note: Both SMEs and large enterprises qualify; the 45%/50% financing percentages quoted here are the rates for small companies. The product must be ready for the market within five years.

programmes.source_snippet: Open voor aanvragen ... maximaal 45% (zonder samenwerking) / maximaal 50% (met samenwerking) ... € 10 miljoen (technisch) / € 5 miljoen (klinisch) ... budget € 50.000.000.

programmes.name_en: MIT R&D collaboration projects (SME innovation stimulus for region and top sectors)
programmes.funder: Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) with the provinces and top sectors
programmes.amount_note: Subsidy amounts and rates are set per instrument and per region in the annual regulation; the RVO landing page states only that a kennisvoucher is worth 'maximaal 70% van de rekening'. No national R&D-samenwerking ceiling is quoted on that page, so none is recorded here.
programmes.deadline_note: MIT R&D-samenwerkingsprojecten: 'Open voor aanvragen ... vanaf 9 juni tot en met 17 september 2026'. The MIT AI variant is closed. Kennisvouchers, TKI-Netwerkactiviteiten and TKI-Innovatiemakelaars will not reopen ('Dit instrument opent niet meer'), and haalbaarheidsprojecten are no longer run by RVO ('De Haalbaarheidsprojecten worden niet meer uitgevoerd door RVO') — check your province for regional MIT instruments.

procedure_steps.detail: Form a collaboration of at least two independent SMEs with a joint R&D project fitting a top sector agenda.
Check whether to apply nationally (RVO) or through your province.
Submit the application in the window 9 June - 17 September 2026 via mijn.rvo.nl; applications are ranked and awarded by tender.

documents_required.doc: Joint R&D project plan and cost breakdown per partner
Signed collaboration agreement between the SME partners

eligibility.other_note: For Dutch SMEs collaborating on R&D within the top sectors. The de minimis question depends on the specific instrument and regional regulation; RVO's landing page does not state it, so it is left false here rather than guessed.

programmes.source_snippet: R&D-Samenwerkingsprojecten — Open voor aanvragen — vanaf 9 juni tot en met 17 september 2026.

programmes.name_en: WBSO – R&D tax credit (reduction of payroll tax / income tax)
programmes.funder: Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO), on behalf of the Ministry of Economic Affairs
programmes.amount_note: 2026 parameters as published by RVO: first bracket 36% (50% for starters) of the S&O-basis up to EUR 391,020, and 16% above that. Self-employed persons may use a fixed deduction; the flat-rate S&O hourly cost is EUR 29.
programmes.deadline_note: 'De aanvraagtermijnen verschillen voor zzp'ers en ondernemingen met personeel' — application windows differ for the self-employed and for companies with staff, and there are several application moments per year; see the RVO WBSO calendar.

procedure_steps.detail: Check that your project is development work or technical-scientific research carried out within the EU and that you pay Dutch payroll and/or income tax.
Arrange eHerkenning (minimum level 3 with RVO authorisation).
Submit the application yourself via mijn.rvo.nl within the applicable window (typically 1-4 hours of work).
After receiving the S&O-verklaring, offset the amount against payroll tax and keep an S&O administration of hours and costs.

documents_required.doc: eHerkenning level 3 or higher with RVO services authorisation
Project description of the development work / technical-scientific research

documents_required.note: Kept during the project, checked afterwards

eligibility.other_note: Open to entrepreneurs subject to Dutch payroll tax and/or income tax, including self-employed persons (zzp'ers) and starters, who carry out R&D within the EU. Starters get the enhanced 50% first-bracket rate.

programmes.source_snippet: De aanvraagtermijnen verschillen voor zzp'ers en ondernemingen met personeel. (2026: eerste schijf 36%, starters 50%, grens € 391.020, tweede schijf 16%, forfaitair uurtarief € 29.)
